mechanism: Each listed source checkpoint reconstructs with scripts/start-checkpoint.py into a fresh standalone Cargo project. No learner directory is overwritten.

steps.contract: The small immutable first checkpoint described in its source; no later service features are claimed.

An in-memory queue retains at most16 jobs,256-byte payloads, three claims per job, and ten logical ticks per lease. Exact enqueue retries have no new effect; conflicting payloads fail. Expiry permits redelivery and a newer token fences old completion. Cancellation revokes completion. No database, OS clock, background worker, or external effect is implemented.
The current complete reference source with its documented limits, fixtures, tests and operational requirements. Database tests remain explicit opt-in checks where applicable.
